A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same A3 framework and provide readable methods, results, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–D. Corresponding content can be matched reliably; v3 omits v1's NeurIPS Paper Checklist.

before.justification: V1 reports original compression experiments measuring perplexity, downstream accuracy, and inference throughput, with component ablations and additional experiments in Appendix D.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix D, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, quantization compatibility, and calibration experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same QK/OV approximations, CUR-based MLP and RoPE handling, and joint-SVD adaptation for GQA. The objectives, components, and approximation procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain WikiText-2, C4, and SlimPajama evaluations, the same downstream tasks, and the SlimPajama–PTB calibration mixture in Appendix D. No dataset, domain, or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: SVD/FWSVD/SVD-LLM in Figure 2, SVD-LLM in Tables 1–2, CLOVER/Palu and abs(w)/Wanda in Figure 4, and ASVD/SVD-LLM v2 in Table 5. The HQQ comparison also remains unchanged; revised citations do not introduce different baselines.

E3.justification: Appendix B.1.1 changes the stated diagnostic statistic from token-token covariance to correlation. This is a limited revision to the reported measure, but the identical Figure 5 and its unchanged covariance caption leave the intended statistic unclear and do not establish recomputation. Other settings in Section 4 and Appendix C match.

E4.justification: The component ablations, token-dependence diagnostic, quantization compatibility, mixed-rank analysis, and calibration comparisons retain the same questions and evidence. The covariance/correlation wording edit introduces no additional analysis or diagnostic results.

E5.justification: Removing checklist Item 7 deletes the statement that calibration used a fixed random seed and the deterministic-method rationale accompanying averaged accuracy reporting. Neither version supplies confidence intervals, significance tests, or repeated-run uncertainty estimates. This is a disclosure change, without evidence of changed run counts.

E6.justification: Numerical entries and plotted findings match throughout, including Appendix D. For example, Table 1 retains WikiText-2 perplexities of 4.69 for A3 and 7.87 for SVD-LLM on LLaMA-3.1-70B at 10% compression; Tables 5–7 also retain identical results.

T1.justification: The problems, lemmas, theorems, Equations (1)–(48), and Appendix B derivations are unchanged, including the independence assumption. The covariance/correlation wording edit supplies no revised mathematical definition, assumption, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: componentwise functional-loss approximation, GQA/RoPE applicability, model/KV-cache/FLOP reductions, avoidance of runtime overhead, and performance superiority. Quantization and mixed-rank applications were already claimed in v1.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the interpretations concerning weakening token independence in deeper layers, CUR degradation at higher compression, calibration-set overfitting, and quantization compatibility. The alternative-OV storage caveat and custom RoPE-kernel requirement also remain; checklist removal does not remove these substantive limitations.

D1.justification: V3 removes checklist Items 4–5 stating that implementation code was submitted and that the models and datasets are available on HuggingFace. Appendix C retains the same precision, SVD routines, prompting, hardware, and GPU-hour disclosures. The removed statements do not establish any actual withdrawal of resources.

R1.justification: The same cited works and research positioning remain after matching titles, including DeepSeek-V3 under revised authorship metadata and CLOVER under a blogpost-track citation. Changes to dates, author lists, venues, and bibliographic fields do not add or remove substantive related work.

P1.justification: V3 removes the administrative checklist, revises bibliography and citation metadata, adjusts author-contact ordering, and changes covariance to correlation in one passage. The scientific narrative and section organization remain almost identical. The revised HQQ reference contains malformed source text.

P2.justification: Shortened author lists and reformatted references reflow the bibliography, the checklist disappears, and some surrounding prose shifts slightly. Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–7 retain their graphics, captions, and display structures; there are no new or redesigned scientific displays.

improvement.justification: V3 streamlines the bibliography and removes checklist boilerplate, but also loses unique seed and code/data-source disclosures. Figure 5 now has conflicting covariance/correlation descriptions, and the HQQ reference loses its source URL while gaining malformed text. With the results and proofs unchanged, these limited losses in transparency and precision outweigh the presentation cleanup.
